Sub-requirement: FR-27.3: If the metrics store is slow or unavailable, the charts shall say so, and everything else shall keep working.
Planned check: TC-FR-27.3: With the API answering 503, the charts show a message and the page still works. Tests: TC-FR-27.3a.

Sub-requirement: FR-28.1: An MCP server shall let AI assistants read incident data through the REST API with the caller's personal access token, so the caller's permissions and the audit log apply.
Planned check: TC-FR-28.1: Each read tool forwards the caller's token to a stubbed API; a 401 or 403 becomes a readable tool error. Tests: TC-FR-28.1a, b.

Sub-requirement: FR-28.2: It shall never change an incident's status, or declare or close an incident. Write tools, when added, shall act as the user and be audited.
Planned check: TC-FR-28.2: The server's tool list has no write tool and none that changes status, declares, or closes. Tests: TC-FR-28.2a.

Sub-requirement: FR-28.3: The MCP server shall not access the database directly.
Planned check: TC-FR-28.3: Review: the server has no database settings or driver.
